about: Ketu in each of the twelve bhavas. Ketu withdraws from the affairs of its house and gives insight there instead of possession. Confidence is set lower across the board, as for Rahu.

rules.says: Identity sits loosely: self-doubt that reads as modesty, and an early pull towards something beyond the ordinary.
Money and family ties are held at arm length; speech is spare, and saying less is preferred to explaining.
Courage without display, and a real indifference to winning; siblings keep their distance.
No place feels quite like home; affection for the mother is real but unexpressed, and settling down is resisted.
Sharp insight that arrives without being worked for; matters of children carry sorrow or detachment.
A good house for Ketu: enemies lose interest, illness is understood before it is diagnosed, and healing others comes naturally.
Partnership is present but not leaned on; the spouse is somewhat separate, by temperament or by distance.
The strongest house for Ketu in spiritual terms: genuine facility with the hidden, and little fear of endings.
Faith that was never learned from anyone, alongside detachment from the father and from inherited religion.
Work is done as duty rather than ambition; recognition arrives and is not much enjoyed.
Few friends but real ones, and an indifference to gain that tends to reduce it.
The classical placement for liberation: withdrawal, foreign ground, and a life that quietly lets go of what it has.
